title: Rare Records of Tropical Spiders Preying on Vertebrates in Southwest China热带地区罕见的蜘蛛捕食脊椎动物记录:来自中国西南部的四例观察
content:
This study reports four rare events of spiders preying on vertebrates in the Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Southwest China. The predators included a giant golden orb-weaver, huntsman spiders, and a wandering spider, while the prey consisted of a small bird, a blind snake, a gecko, and a tiny shrew. These observations reveal that large spiders occasionally capture vertebrates, extending our understanding of their ecological roles in tropical food webs. The multi-day predation by Nephila pilipes on a bird highlights the energetic benefits of rare large prey, emphasizing the significance of spiders as hidden players in vertebrate population dynamics and tropical biodiversity conservation.


ABSTRACT

We report four rare instances of spider–vertebrate predation documented at the Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden in Southwest China. The predatory events involved four spider species: Nephila pilipes (Nephilidae), an unidentified Bowie sp. (Ctenidae), Heteropoda venatoria, and H. tetrica (Sparassidae). The prey taxa included representatives from avian, reptilian (snake and gecko), and mammalian (shrew) classes. These unusual predation occurrences highlight previously underreported trophic interactions in Asia and underscore the potential impact of large spiders on vertebrate prey dynamics in tropical ecosystems. Notably, repeated avian predation by Nephila pilipes over a 3-day period provided valuable insights into spider feeding behavior. These findings expand current knowledge of spider predation on vertebrates and trophic roles, highlighting the ecological and conservation significance of large-bodied spiders in Asian tropical biodiversity hotspots.

摘要

本文记录了四例发生在中国西南部的罕见的蜘蛛捕食脊椎动物事件。捕食者包括四种大型蜘蛛:斑络新妇 (Nephila pilipes)、一种未鉴定的鲍伊蛛属 (Bowie sp.) 蜘蛛、白额高脚蛛 (Heteropoda venatoria) 和狂放巨蟹蛛 (Heteropoda tetrica)。被捕食的脊椎动物涵盖鸟类、爬行动物 (蛇和壁虎) 及哺乳动物 (鼩鼱) 。这些记录不仅丰富了亚洲地区关于蜘蛛捕食脊椎动物的地理分布与生态学资料, 也揭示了大型蜘蛛在热带生态系统中潜在的重要生态角色。尤其值得关注的是, 我们首次记录了亚洲地区鲍伊蛛属蜘蛛捕食盲蛇的案例, 以及斑络新妇连续三天捕食小型鸟类的行为。这些发现强调了大型蜘蛛在热带生物多样性热点地区食物网中的复杂作用, 并凸显了它们对生态系统功能与保护的重要意义。
